sentences.text: The genus name Abrosaurus translates to 'delicate lizard' in Greek.
This dinosaur possessed a boxy head featuring a tall bony arch that contained its nostrils, along with large openings separated by thin bone bars.
It was a relatively small sauropod, reaching a maximum length of 9.1 meters and weighing approximately 10 tons.
The species name 'dongpoi' honors the Chinese poet Su Shi, also known as Su Dongpo, and was corrected in 1999 to follow nomenclature rules for male individuals.
The fossil was discovered in 1984 and first described in a 1986 doctoral thesis by Chinese paleontologist Ouyang Hui, who formally named the species in 1989.
The holotype specimen, designated ZDM 5038, is a nearly complete and well-preserved skull found at the Dashanpu Quarry near Zigong, China.
While originally classified as a camarasaurid, research suggests Abrosaurus is a basal member of Macronaria.
The Paleobiology Database lists the parent group of Abrosaurus as Mamenchisauridae.
Abrosaurus lived during the Middle Jurassic Period, approximately 168 to 161 million years ago, with the Paleobiology Database recording a range from 170.9 to 154.8 million years ago.
The exact placement of Abrosaurus in the sauropod family tree remains difficult to determine because its remains have not been fully described.
